description: This file defines a React custom hook named useRealtimeStudents. It checks environment feature flags to conditionally set up a real-time subscription, intended for future extension with Supabase to listen for student data changes.

methods.name: useRealtimeStudents(enabledFlag = false)
methods.description: A React hook that monitors the 'realtime' feature flag and sets up a placeholder for a real-time subscription related to students.
